purpose: Teach: 誓っ/ぎっしり/ノルマ/砂浜/ダメージ/贈っ/学芸/あ〜

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、家族を守るって誓っていらしたのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father made a vow to protect this family.
lines.style: Soft, almost confessional. Speaking more to herself than to him. Warm but grave. A mother tending to something tender and difficult at once.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのお弁当、ぎっしりおいしそうだよ
lines.en: Mom, my lunch box looks so full and delicious!
lines.style: Bright, genuine wonder. Quick eager energy. The naturalness of a child discovering something good without performing about it. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、お仕事のノルマで遅くなるそうよ
lines.en: Your father's work quota means he'll be late coming home, sweetheart.
lines.style: Measured, accepting. Not complaining, just naming a thing. Breath held steady. A mother bearing small disappointments so her child doesn't have to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと砂浜行きたいな
lines.en: I wish I could go to the beach with Dad, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet wanting. Genuine longing, not demanding. A small voice carrying something bigger. Soft trailing-off, like he's already accepted the answer before asking.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達にダメージを与えないでね
lines.en: Sho, be gentle with your friends, won't you?
lines.style: Quiet redirection. Not scolding. The firmness underneath is real but delivered with care. A reminder more than a reproof.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんにお花を贈ったよ
lines.en: I gave flowers to Grandma today, Mom.
lines.style: Simple pride. No performance, just fact-sharing with a note of accomplishment. Small but genuine. The warmth of being seen for doing something right.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、学芸会、ママも見に行くわ
lines.en: I'll come watch your school play, Sho.
lines.style: Warm promise. Not fussy or overdone. Direct and steady. The reassurance of a mother keeping what matters on her calendar.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、あ〜、もうお風呂入らなきゃ
lines.en: Mom, oh — I need to take a bath now.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact announcement. A child remembering duty without drama. Quick tempo. Slight wry acceptance of bedtime logistics.
